newsitem.title: USA: Berlitz to buy ELS for $95 mln.
newsitem.headline: Berlitz to buy ELS for $95 mln.

text.p: Berlitz International Inc on Wednesday said it agreed to acquire ELS Educational Services Inc, a privately held provider of English language instruction, for $95 million.
Closing of the acquisition, which is subject to certain conditions, is expected to occur in early September, Berlitz said in a statement.
Financing for the transaction, and simultaneous refinancing of existing long term debt, will be provided by NationsBank, Berlitz said.
Goldman Sachs & Co acted as financial adviser to Berlitz. Montgomery Securities acted as financial adviser to ELS.
ELS owns and operates 25 language centers in the United States and two in England.
ELS generated consolidated 1996 revenue of $62.6 million.
